feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 5 September 2026 8:06am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 05 September 2026 at 8:00am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds later.


##Synopsis##

High pressure to the south of Ireland builds a ridge across the area.


##Wind##

West 4 or 5, decreasing mainly 4 occasionally 5 in places from mid-morning. Backing southwest this afternoon, then south this evening, and increasing 5 or 6 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, but soon becoming slight for a time until around midnight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, then outbreaks of rain arriving overnight into Sunday.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, falling moderate in rain later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South 5 or 6, although occasionally 3 or 4 in the southeast of the area, veering southwest 4 to 6 later on Sunday, then veering west 4 or 5 overnight into Monday.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate becoming slight later.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or drizzle at first, fair for a time Sunday morning and afternoon, then occasional rain again later on Sunday.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or drizzle.
